subject: Sending data from JS to SHINY

messages.author: 005076ab0c360c3b
messages.subject: Sending data from JS to SHINY
parts:
Thanks for releasing the new shiny 13.0 and including JS Events in the new version. Very helpful :) Beautiful what you did to debugg reactive apps btw. :)

However, I wonder if there is any way to send data from JS back to shiny/R? 
As described http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/js-events.html it seems that this is a one way street. Only data from Shiny can be send to JS, but not back. What if I need data that is created in JS in my shiny/R Application for further process? There still is this undocumented feature https://ryouready.wordpress.com/2013/11/20/sending-data-from-client-to-server-and-back-using-shiny/ which works. However, did you include a way to send data from JS back to shiny?

messages.author: 68ce5dd269fd758c
messages.subject: Re: Sending data from JS to SHINY
parts:
To send data from JS to Shiny, you need a shiny container, like textInput, and then you need write some js script like: 


var x = "Hello world!"
var tar = $("#id")  // where the id is the id of a textInput of your shiny-app.
tar.val(x)
tar.trigger("change")

I suppose you know how to programme with JS.
